name: obsidian
title: Obsidian
description: Your Obsidian vault in the panel: find any note by title, search the full text, append to today's daily note and start new notes from a template. Notes open in Obsidian or your editor, or read right in the panel.
author: pal

settings.label: Vault
settings.description: The vault folder. Empty takes the vault Obsidian has open, or opened last (obsidian.json).

settings.label: Open with
settings.description: What Enter does on a note; cmd+Enter is the other one.

settings.label: Editor
settings.description: The command Open in editor runs with the file's path last (code, subl, zed). Empty opens the file with whatever the OS opens .md files with.

settings.label: Daily notes folder
settings.description: Where daily notes live, relative to the vault. Empty reads Obsidian's daily-notes plugin (.obsidian/daily-notes.json).

settings.label: Daily note name
settings.description: The date format of a daily note's name, moment's tokens as Obsidian takes them. Empty reads the plugin; YYYY-MM-DD when it says nothing.

settings.label: Daily note template
settings.description: The note a new daily note starts as, relative to the vault ({{date}}, {{time}}, {{title}} filled). Empty reads the plugin.

settings.label: New note template
settings.description: The note New note starts as, relative to the vault ({{title}}, {{date}}, {{time}} filled). Empty starts from your selection or the clipboard.

settings.label: Exclude
settings.description: Folders and files left out of every palette, as globs relative to the vault. Dot folders (.obsidian, .trash) are always out.

store.tagline: Find, search and add to your Obsidian notes
features: Every note at the root by title, alias, tag or folder; `enter` opens it in Obsidian, `cmd+enter` in your editor
Full-text search across the vault as you type, the matching line under each note
Today's daily note, created from its template if missing; Append to today adds a line
New notes from a template; tags, recent notes, backlinks and outgoing links
Read a note in the panel with its headings, callouts, code and tables (`cmd+shift+r`)
`cmd+c` copies a `[[wikilink]]`; the list stays in step with the vault on disk

screenshots.caption: Notes: every note by title, sectioned by folder, tags and the change date on the row
The pane: the note rendered, callout and table included, its tags, links and backlinks below
Search Notes: the matching line on each row, the matches bold in the pane
Daily Notes: today, yesterday, this week, Append to today, New note
Append to today: one line, the clipboard already in it, lands at the end of today's note
A note read in pal: callouts, lists, code and tables drawn with the tokens

actions.title: Open in Obsidian
actions.description: The note in Obsidian, through obsidian://open; first or second per the Open with setting.

actions.title: Open in editor
actions.description: The editor command with the file's path; the OS opener without one.

actions.title: Copy wikilink
actions.description: [[name]], or [[folder/name]] when another note shares the name.

actions.title: Read in pal
actions.description: The note drawn in the panel.

actions.title: Backlinks
actions.description: The notes that link to it.

actions.title: Outgoing links
actions.description: The notes it links to; a link to nothing yet offers Create the note.

actions.title: Append a line
actions.description: The line typed in the bar (the note row's argument) lands at the end of the note, placeholders filled; a form when picked without it.

actions.title: Create today's note
actions.description: From the daily template; asks first.

actions.title: Append to today
actions.description: The line typed in the bar lands on its own line at the end of today's note; from Today's note's cmd+enter, a form.

actions.title: New note
actions.description: The title and the folder typed in the bar; the body from the template or your selection.

actions.title: Notes with the tag
actions.description: On a tag row: the notes carrying it.

actions.title: Search in Obsidian
actions.description: On the Search notes command: Obsidian's own search.

open.description: Open a note in Obsidian or the editor

path.description: The note's path in the vault (with or without .md) or its name as a wikilink says it

new.description: Create a note and open it

title.description: The title, also the file name

body.description: The markdown body; {{title}} and {{date}} are filled

folder.description: A folder of the vault; the top when empty

append-today.description: Append a line to today's daily note, created when missing

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Every note of the vault by title, alias, tag or folder, sectioned by folder; Today's note, New note (the title and the folder typed in the bar), Search notes and Random note at the top.

keys.title: Open in Obsidian (or the editor, per the setting)
Append the line typed in the bar

search.title: Search Notes
search.description: Full-text over every note as you type: ripgrep when on PATH, a one-second scan otherwise; the matching line on the row, the matches bold in the pane.

keys.title: Open in Obsidian (or the editor, per the setting)
Append the line typed in the bar

daily.title: Daily Notes
daily.description: Today's note (created from the template when missing), yesterday's, this week's; Append to today and New note, their values typed in the bar.

keys.title: Open the note; on Create today's note, create it (asks first); on Append to today and New note, with the line, or the title and folder, typed in the bar's fields
Append the line typed in the bar

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Every tag in the vault with how many notes carry it; Enter lists them.

recent.title: Recent Notes
recent.description: The twenty notes changed last, newest first.

keys.title: Open in Obsidian (or the editor, per the setting)
Append the line typed in the bar

backlinks.title: Backlinks
backlinks.description: The notes that link to the note you opened last, or to the row cmd+b came from.

outgoing.title: Outgoing Links
outgoing.description: The notes the note you opened last links to, or the row cmd+l came from; a link to nothing yet offers Create the note.
